programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5
programme.desc: In this final episode, Tianran journeys to Nyingchi, known as “Xizang’s Garden.” Here, he experiences the region’s semi-pastoral way of life — feeding yaks, trying his hand at archery, and seeing how tourism is transforming lives in Lulang International Tourist Town. Travelling along National Highway 318, Tianran discovers towering millennia-old cypress trees and rafts through the vast Yani National Wetland Park, before ending the day with a unique spa treatment at a traditional Tibetan hospital.

programme.title: Walk Again: A New Hope for Paralysis Recovery
programme.desc: A groundbreaking medical technology in China is offering new hope to people with paralysis. In Hangzhou, doctors and engineers at Second Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine have developed a closed-loop spinal cord neural interface that helps reconnect signals between the brain and muscles, allowing patients with spinal cord injuries to stand and walk again. This episode follows patients and doctors through a pioneering surgery and the long road to recovery - exploring whether technology can help the human body walk again.

programme.title: Rate Decision Week in Focus
programme.desc: The Fed has resumed rate hikes for the first time in three years, while the Bank of Japan is set to make its next move. With energy prices elevated and inflation pressures persisting, central banks are turning more hawkish. Will tightening continue? And what does it mean for the dollar, yen, renminbi, Treasuries and gold? This week on BizTalk, we take a closer look at the new global rate cycle and its market impact.#BizTalk

programme.title: Vive La Tech: Approaching the limits of temperature measurement
programme.desc: In this episode of CGTN's special program "Vive La Tech," we dive into the "frozen world". In low-temperature metrology, scientists created the world's most precise temperature measuring device, from 5 to 24.5 kelvin, providing a source for all thermometers around the world. Join CGTN reporter Yang Zhao to explore how such an innovative partnership can open new doors for fundamental science.

programme.title: Vive la Tech: Climate change is changing French wine
programme.desc: CGTN's new special program "Vive La Tech" focuses on some of the coolest science collaborations between China and France. In this episode, we shift our attention to climate change and the grape at risk. Follow our reporter Yang Zhao into the vineyards.

programme.title: Meet China: Starting Green, Reaching the Future
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, wind becomes more than a natural force—it powers a greener future across China and Europe. A piece of fabric reveals how Chinese innovation is reshaping global perceptions of manufacturing. Ancient ruins in central China are reimagined as immersive cultural experiences, turning heritage into living memory. And in Laos, Chinese agricultural expertise is helping farmers unlock higher yields and new opportunities. From energy and textiles to tourism and farming, this episode shows how innovation is renewing tradition and connecting futures across borders.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money!
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next?
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.title: RAZOR: Wooden Windmills
programme.desc: As we shift to green energy, it's important to ask - how green is the infrastructure itself? Take wind power: a typical onshore turbine needs around 480 tonnes of steel, and producing just one tonne of steel or cement releases up to two tonnes of CO2. In Sweden, engineers at Modvion are tackling this problem by building wind turbine towers out of wood. RAZOR meets the team behind Wind of Change, one of the tallest wooden towers in the world. Co-founder David Olivegren got the idea while building a boat, while CEO Otto Lundman explains how sustainably sourced wood is turned into strong, lightweight Laminated Veneer Lumber (LVL). CFO Maria-Lina Hedlund shares how the company aims to scale...

programme.title: Walk Again: A New Hope for Paralysis Recovery
programme.desc: A groundbreaking medical technology in China is offering new hope to people with paralysis. In Hangzhou, doctors and engineers at Second Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine have developed a closed-loop spinal cord neural interface that helps reconnect signals between the brain and muscles, allowing patients with spinal cord injuries to stand and walk again. This episode follows patients and doctors through a pioneering surgery and the long road to recovery - exploring whether technology can help the human body walk again.

programme.title: Rate Decision Week in Focus
programme.desc: The Fed has resumed rate hikes for the first time in three years, while the Bank of Japan is set to make its next move. With energy prices elevated and inflation pressures persisting, central banks are turning more hawkish. Will tightening continue? And what does it mean for the dollar, yen, renminbi, Treasuries and gold? This week on BizTalk, we take a closer look at the new global rate cycle and its market impact.#BizTalk

programme.title: Vive La Tech: Approaching the limits of temperature measurement
programme.desc: In this episode of CGTN's special program "Vive La Tech," we dive into the "frozen world". In low-temperature metrology, scientists created the world's most precise temperature measuring device, from 5 to 24.5 kelvin, providing a source for all thermometers around the world. Join CGTN reporter Yang Zhao to explore how such an innovative partnership can open new doors for fundamental science.

programme.title: Vive la Tech: Climate change is changing French wine
programme.desc: CGTN's new special program "Vive La Tech" focuses on some of the coolest science collaborations between China and France. In this episode, we shift our attention to climate change and the grape at risk. Follow our reporter Yang Zhao into the vineyards.

programme.title: Meet China: Starting Green, Reaching the Future
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, wind becomes more than a natural force—it powers a greener future across China and Europe. A piece of fabric reveals how Chinese innovation is reshaping global perceptions of manufacturing. Ancient ruins in central China are reimagined as immersive cultural experiences, turning heritage into living memory. And in Laos, Chinese agricultural expertise is helping farmers unlock higher yields and new opportunities. From energy and textiles to tourism and farming, this episode shows how innovation is renewing tradition and connecting futures across borders.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Malaysia's rice has a secret superpower
programme.desc: Despite its fertile tropical landscape, Malaysia produces only around two-thirds of the rice it needs. Chinese ratoon rice technology is now being applied to lift yields and enhance food security—unlocking new potential for tropical farming. Discover more in CGTN's special series #FarmedwithChina. #Chinavsionary

programme.title: Farmed with China: Vietnam's food trade levels up
programme.desc: How is Vietnam's cassava industry reaching global markets? With technical support and cross-border cooperation with China, one crop is moving up the value chain — from local farms to international supply chains.

programme.title: Farmed with China: Thailand's farms go high-tech
programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money!
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. Alongside China-Laos Railway strengthening the supply chain, grain production is also gaining a stronger foundation. Explore the story in CGTN's special series Farmed With China.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next?
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. From the future of employment to the deepening divide over AI governance and technological sovereignty, this conversation brings together perspectives from the US, China, and the global stage on how AI is reshaping economies, societies, and geopolitics.

programme.desc: The body of Nathalie Villermet, 46, manager of a small hotel and -restaurant, is found by a walker in the woods outside Paris, hidden under branches.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Xavier Flactif, his partner Graziella and their three children suddenly disappear; there are many theories surrounding this mysterious case.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless, mutilated body of a woman is found in the Rambouillet Forest; the police are perplexed by the clues found at the crime scene and the state of the body which is missing both the head and heart.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year-old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a car accident while on his honeymoon; Marc's wife, Aurore, isn't injured in the accident and the case is quickly dismissed; Marc's family is suspicious of Aurore.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 52-year-old Marina Ciampi is found dead at her home in Marseille; she is found naked on her bed with a plastic bag over her head, but there is no trace of a break-in; police investigate several unknown DNA traces.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On 1 December 2005, Dominique Aubry, a wealthy widow, is found hanged in her houseboat in Neuilly; the case is quickly classified as a suicide, but this argument is problematic.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente are called to a fire at a large house in the village; they arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, 83-year-old Claude Tavernier, lying in a large pool of blood.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 18-year-old Laetitia Perrais is a trainee hotel waitress who vanishes after an evening shift; every attempt is made to shed light on her disappearance and the efforts eventually pay off.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case): On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. The case soon ignites public opinion, even inflaming passions at the highest level of the state. The clues lead investigators on a number of trails, from the shadows of the French secret service to a manhunt for a possible sex maniac, in a case of murder most foul.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! An extensive search is undertaken but the woman cannot be found. What has happened to Adeline Piet? The investigation spans several years and experiences many twists.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and -an extra sordid detail - a devil mask is found next to her body. Was Priscillia the victim of a prowler? A serial killer? A maniac inspired by a horror movie? Investigators soon find that the young girl felt she was being watched, and even threatened...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending "Teknival" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer from among the 43,000 participants of this huge open-air festival of electronic music, where drink and drugs are consumed in abundance. An unusual investigation that leads the police down a number of false avenues.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written "DIRTY RAPIST". Yet Jean-Raymond Blatti was never charged with sexual assault. Over the course of the investigation, this inscription will appear as one of the many mysteries of this case which is particularly rich in twists and turns.

programme.title: Raider Of The Lost Art
programme.desc: When Van Gogh died, he was a complete unknown, his paintings fetching under 10 dollars. So how did his works become some of the most revered and expensive in the world? His sister-in-law Johanna is to thank for that. With a new Van Gogh having been discovered just last year, where are the rest?

programme.title: Raider Of The Lost Art
programme.desc: During WWII the Nazis plundered some of the world's greatest artworks as they tore across Europe. We find out how the Allies tracked them down, what they saved, and what is still missing to this day.

programme.title: Raider Of The Lost Art
programme.desc: The story of the theft of the Mona Lisa in 1911 from the Louvre and how Pablo Picasso was accused of the crime. Plus, the incredible tales of how many other of da Vinci's works were lost to history and had to be reclaimed.

programme.title: Raider Of The Lost Art
programme.desc: The Dutch didn't appreciate what they had. For 200 years Vermeer was completely forgotten. Trying to recover a lost man's masterpieces has driven men to great extremes and gave rise to one of the greatest forgers the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money: Part 1, A Not So Simple Plan
programme.sub-title: S2:E19 Liars, Guns And Money: Part 1, A Not So Simple Plan
programme.desc: Stark helps the crew with a plan to steal money from a depository to free D'Argo's son, Jothee, from slavery.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money: Part 2, With Friends Like These
programme.sub-title: S2:E20 Liars, Guns And Money: Part 2, With Friends Like These
programme.desc: With the loot from the Depository heist at hand, D'Argo waits to make contact with the Slave Traders.

programme.title: Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
programme.sub-title: S2:E21 Liars, Guns And Money, Part 3: Plan B
programme.desc: The crew breaks into the depository to free Crichton with the help of Talyn's unexpected arrival.

programme.title: Die Me, Dichotomy
programme.desc: The crew meets with a famous surgeon whom they hope can heal Moya's burns and remove Crichton's neural chip.

programme.title: Season Of Death
programme.desc: D'Argo and Stark try to heal John, while Scorpius tries to avoid discovery. Zhaan makes a personal sacrifice.

programme.title: Suns And Lovers
programme.desc: Moya docks at a commerce station. Disaster strikes when the station is hit by a storm.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.sub-title: S3:E3 Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 1: Could'a, Would'a, Should'a
programme.desc: Moya approaches a wormhole, gets pulled in and fused to another ship.

programme.title: Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.sub-title: S3:E4 Self Inflicted Wounds, Part 2: Wait For The Wheel
programme.desc: The crew escapes the other ship and wormhole. Things are complicated when their new 'friends' sabotage Moya.

programme.title: Different Destinations
programme.desc: Stark accidentally sends himself, Crichton, Aeryn. D'Argo and Jool back in time where they alter the timeline.

programme.title: Eat Me
programme.desc: Crichton lands his transport pod on a dying leviathan full of cannibals and a scientist who can create clones.

programme.title: Thanks For Sharing
programme.desc: Moya rendezvous with Talyn who is seriously hurt. D'Argo and Rygel try to find Clorium, a drug to help Talyn.

programme.title: Green Eyed Monster
programme.desc: Talyn is swallowed by a boodong, leaving Stark and Rygel stranded in a transport pod.

programme.title: Losing Time
programme.desc: Moya's crew starts blacking out and missing portions of time. Pilot becomes inhabited by another entity.

programme.title: Relativity
programme.desc: Talyn lands on a planet covered with healing plants. Crichton, Aeryn and Crais leave the ship to find Xhalax.

programme.title: Incubator
programme.desc: Scorpius puts the neural chip into his own brain in an attempt to retrieve vital wormhole equations from Crichton.

programme.title: Meltdown
programme.desc: Talyn wants to fly into a sun. While near it Stark is contacted by an alien woman being held against her will.

programme.title: Scratch N Sniff
programme.desc: Pilot forces Crichton, D'Argo, Jool and Chiana to take a holiday as he is fed up with their bickering.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.sub-title: S3:E14 Infinite Possibilities, Part 1: Daedalus Demands
programme.desc: Crichton must seek out an old friend who has gained too much knowledge about wormholes.

programme.title: Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programme.sub-title: S3:E15 Infinite Possibilities, Part 2: Icarus Abides
programme.desc: Jack unlocks Crichton's wormhole knowledge so they can build a device to destroy the Scarran dreadnought.

programme.title: Revenging Angel
programme.desc: D'Argo injures Crichton, as Crichton lies in a coma/near death, he escapes into a highly animated world.

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aeryn leaves to grieve on a planet. She spots someone who might be her father but not all reunions are happy.

programme.title: Fractures
programme.desc: Escaped prisoners come aboard Moya followed shortly by Aeryn, Crais and Rygel who have returned from Talyn.

programme.title: I - Yensch, You - Yensch
programme.desc: D'Argo and Rygel meet Braca and Scorpius in a cafe to conduct negotiations when it is unexpectedly attacked.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.sub-title: S3:E20 Into The Lion's Den, Part 1: Lambs To The Slaughter
programme.desc: The crew must stop Scorpius's research. They must board the command carrier and destroy it from within.

programme.title: Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.sub-title: S3:E21 Into The Lion's Den, Part 2: Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
programme.desc: Crais gets Talyn to starburst inside the command carrier, causing it to collapse in on itself.

programme.title: Dog With Two Bones
programme.desc: Moya takes Talyn's remains to the sacred burial ground. D'Argo destroys a Leviathan that attacks other ships.

programme.title: Crichton Kicks
programme.desc: Crichton, now aboard a dying leviathan, encounters an alien named Sikozu who aids him in stopping the Grudeks.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.sub-title: S4:E2 What Was Lost, Part 1: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Everyone but Aeryn meets on Arnesk, where Jool has discovered the remains of an ancient civilization.

programme.title: What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.sub-title: S4:E3 What Was Lost, Part 2: Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew discovers Scorpius has fallen in the Peacekeeper ranks. They must stop the magnetic storm on Arnesk.

programme.title: Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.sub-title: S4:E4 Lava's A Many Splendored Thing
programme.desc: The crew is enroute to meet with Moya. They eat Noranti's concoction and raiders entomb Rygel in amber.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Everyone reunites on Moya. Aeryn returns with Scorpius, who claims he saved the former Peacekeeper's life.

programme.title: Natural Election
programme.desc: Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.

programme.title: John Quixote
programme.desc: Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange/twisted versions of their friends.

programme.title: I Shrink Therefore I Am
programme.sub-title: S4:E8 I Shrink Therefore I Am
programme.desc: When Moya is raided by Peacekeeper bounty hunters, everyone is captured except for Crichton and Noranti.

programme.title: A Prefect Murder
programme.desc: While Moya's crew are resupplying on a xenophobic planet, Aeryn kills the next prefect.

programme.title: Coup By Clam
programme.desc: The crew consume food, sharing amongst themselves. But if not ingested by the same person, it becomes deadly.

programme.title: Unrealized Reality
programme.desc: Crichton falls into a wormhole and meets a strange man who shows Crichton the consequences of wormhole travel.

programme.title: Kansas
programme.desc: Crichton accidentally alters the past, causing his dad to fly on the doomed shuttle 'Challenger'.

programme.title: Terra Firma
programme.desc: Crichton has arrived home. Although the crew relaxes, Crichton can't seem to adjust to life on Earth.

programme.title: Twice Shy
programme.desc: Moya takes on a new passenger, but she is an alien in disguise, intent on harvesting the crew's neural energy.

programme.title: Mental As Anything
programme.desc: The crew's males undergo training. Crichton learns how to resist Scarran probes, D'Argo learns self control.

programme.title: Bringing Home The Beacon
programme.desc: The women of Moya travel to a dead Leviathan to buy a sensor beacon that will allow Moya to camouflage.

programme.title: A Constellation Of Doubt
programme.desc: John Crichton struggles to learn the location of the mysterious Katratzi, whilst watching a tv documentary.

programme.title: Prayer
programme.desc: Crichton and Scorpius travel to one of the 'unrealized realities'. Aeryn resists torture on a Scarran ship.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction
programme.sub-title: S4:E19 We're So Screwed, Part 1: Fetal Attraction
programme.desc: The crew goes after Aeryn on a Scarran controlled station.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi
programme.sub-title: S4:E20 We're So Screwed, Part 2: Hot To Katratzi
programme.desc: Moya arrives at Katratzi. Crichton attends peace talks between Scarrans and Peacekeepers with a nuclear bomb.

programme.title: We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba
programme.sub-title: S4:E21 We're So Screwed, Part 3: La Bomba
programme.desc: Scorpius has betrayed the crew. Now they're all captured. The plan failed so the crew must help Scorpius.

programme.title: Bad Timing
programme.desc: With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans travel through a wormhole to Earth, where those flowers grow.

programme.title: Premiere
programme.desc: Astronaut John Crichton is sucked through a wormhole into a distant part of the universe.

programme.title: Exodus From Genesis
programme.desc: A locator beacon on Moya is automatically broadcasting its exact location to Peacekeeper forces in the area.

programme.title: Back And Back And Back To The Future
programme.sub-title: S1:E3 Back And Back And Back To The Future
programme.desc: The crew rescues a scientist and his assistant from a disintegrating ship.

programme.title: Throne For A Loss
programme.desc: Rygel is captured by bounty hunters. He stole a crystal from Moya and she will crash if it isn't returned.

programme.title: PK Tech Girl
programme.desc: The crew finds the Zelbinion battleship. They work to get the shield functional before it's attacked again.

programme.title: Thank God It's Friday, Again
programme.sub-title: S1:E6 Thank God It's Friday, Again
programme.desc: The crew visits a planet of happy workers. Rygel's fluids become explosive. Aeryn and Pilot must learn why.

programme.title: I, E.T.
programme.desc: A peacekeeper beacon goes off and Moya has to land on an alien planet to prevent its signal being intercepted and Moya being discovered.

programme.title: That Old Black Magic
programme.desc: Crichton and Crais's spirits are captured by Maldis, who thrives on hate. Zhaan takes a dark path to fight.

programme.title: DNA Mad Scientist
programme.desc: A scientist extracts DNA from several of Moya's crew and promises to use it to find their home planets.

programme.title: They've Got A Secret
programme.desc: During routine searches for Peacekeeper beacons, D'Argo falls down a chute and gets ejected into open space.

programme.title: Til The Blood Runs Clear
programme.sub-title: S1:E11 Til The Blood Runs Clear
programme.desc: John and Aeryn avoid getting sucked into an unstable wormhole while flying his ship near a high flare sun.

programme.title: The Flax
programme.desc: Aeryn takes Crichton out in a transport pod for flying lessons but they get stuck in the Flax, a space trap.

programme.title: Rhapsody In Blue
programme.desc: Z'han joins her own people, but one of them wants something from her and will do almost anything to take it.

programme.title: Jeremiah Crichton
programme.desc: Crichton is left behind in Farscape One when Moya suddenly starbursts as a result of her pregnancy.

programme.title: Durka Returns
programme.desc: Moya collides with a Nebari ship. Durka is on board and has been mind cleansed. He now serves the Nebari.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY double champ Chico Kwasi (46-6-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world championship in the main event in a trilogy fight against top Bulgarian Teodor Hristov (20-5, 8 KO). A gigantic heavyweight clash takes place as former interim heavyweight champion Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (31-5-1, 17 KO) collides with the legend Errol ‘The Bonecrusher’ Zimmerman (112-21-1, 45 KO). Also happening at GLORY 109 are the Welterweight Proving Grounds. Several match-ups will take place where fighters aim to impress in order to put their names forward for the GLORY welterweight eight-man grand prix at the end of the year.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.sub-title: S00 : E01 GLORY 105: Last Heavyweight Standing Finals
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY double champ Chico Kwasi (46-6-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world championship in the main event in a trilogy fight against top Bulgarian Teodor Hristov (20-5, 8 KO). A gigantic heavyweight clash takes place as former interim heavyweight champion Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (31-5-1, 17 KO) collides with the legend Errol ‘The Bonecrusher’ Zimmerman (112-21-1, 45 KO). Also happening at GLORY 109 are the Welterweight Proving Grounds. Several match-ups will take place where fighters aim to impress in order to put their names forward for the GLORY welterweight eight-man grand prix at the end of the year.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 Garbanzo Beans and Grapefruit
programme.desc: In this fast-paced episode, host Theresa Visintin uses two unlikely ingredients that start with the letter "G," garbanzo beans and grapefruit! First up, Theresa cooks socca, a savoury garbanzo bean pancake recipe, and infuses it with Mediterranean flavours. To make her batter, Theresa combines chickpea flour with salty olives, sweet red pepper, and fresh basil. Once the batter is ready to go, she fries the savoury crepe. Next up, Theresa balances tart grapefruit with a sweet buttery lobster tail. But that's not sweet enough for Theresa! She prepares sabayon, a delicate honey custard that melts in your mouth. Finally, Theresa shows us how to make a mouth-watering dish by combining grapefruit and garbanzo.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Chicken and corn are the key players in this letter “C” challenge. Chef Lauren Gulyas prepares one of her favourite Italian dishes, chicken Marsala. Using garlic, shallots, and white wine, Chef Lauren whips up a rich Marsala sauce that is nutty and floral in flavour. Next, she transforms corn into a creamy polenta topping for her Shepard’s pie...with a twist! Sautéing onion, garlic, and lean ground beef, she uses Worcestershire sauce and tomato paste to give the pie filling an extra flavour boost. Once she finishes those dishes, Chef Lauren creates a mouth-watering recipe that combines both chicken and corn.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie writes to the son of an old female pedlar, unaware that he is a member of an outlaw gang, now on their way to Diablo. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. Also starring Slim Pickens. This entertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.sub-title: S03 : E23 The Saga of Clement O' Toole
programme.desc: Mistaken for a notorious outlaw, a young man struggles to convince the townspeople that he didnt commit a stagecoach robbery. Initially, Annie and Susan Meriwether believe him, but his innocence comes into question when he is present during a bank robbery in which the outlaws seem to recognize him. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: With the sheriff off looking for an outlaw, a fake sheriff takes his place, leading to a senseless murder. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This enetertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Waiting to hear whether or not gold has been struck in the mine, Annie discovers a beloved stagecoach is being driven by the daughter of the owner, whos threatening to sell the stage so he can pocket the money. When word comes back that there is no gold in the money, Annie becomes suspicious and begins investigating. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Annie Calls Her Shots
programme.desc: After a jailed Dobie escapes from jail, Dobie and Tagg find themselves kidnapped, forcing a desperate Annie to rescue her brother. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This entertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Valley of the Shadows
programme.desc: Annie tries to help a blind girl find her father's killer. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. Directed by Robert G. Walker. Also starring Judy Nugent, Forrest Taylor, and Denver Pyle. This entertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Annie and the Lily Maid
programme.desc: Choctaw looks to inherit the ranch of the murdered Sam Forbes, but Elaine, a previously unknown niece, appears, making Annie suspicious as the men fall for her seemingly delicate nature. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Jesse James Rides Again
programme.desc: The outlaw Jesse James and his friend are on the run from the law when he is wrongly accused of leading the historic 1876 Northfield, Minnesota bank robbery. With nerve-tensing turns and high-impact action, Jesse rides into a town where a gang is trying to drive area ranchers off their land because there's oil underneath it. Jesse James takes particular interest in the situation of a pretty young woman and her elderly father, whose ranch is being regularly attacked by the gang.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Loser's End
programme.desc: This spine-tingling drama of the west stars Jack Perrin as a man out for revenge against an outlaw gang. Other stars include Tina Menard as the woman who helps him along the way, and Elias Lazoroff as the daring Don Carlos. Perrin (Jaws of Justice, The Apache Kid's Escape), was a familiar face in low budget westerns, his career spanning back to the silent era.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: William Boyd returns in the 25th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. This time Hopalong goes undercover to expose a group of ranchers who are interfering with the building of a new railroad. Also, look for Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Britt Wood as Speedy McGinnis. It's a great, action-packed adventure from director Leslie Selander (Flight to Mars, Riders of the Range), and further proof that no one pushes Hoppy around and gets away with it!

programme.title: Fighting Caravans
programme.desc: Clint Belmet (Gary Cooper) is a frontier scout with his hands full in this 1931 Paramount Pictures version of Zane Grey's novel. He's helping guide a wagon train across the country, fighting off various attacks on the way, and falling for his lovely Felice (Lily Damita). Belmet's grizzled companions think he should leave the woman alone, but it gets lonely out on the trail, and Felice's charms are hard to resist. Featuring such notable character actors of the period as Ernest Torrence, Tully Marshall, and Fred Kolher, this vintage Hollywood Western still packs a wallop!

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: Painted Desert
programme.desc: A mightly melodrama of red-blooded action, William Boyd stars in the Pre-Code western talkie - The Painted Desert (1931). The first sound film for Hollywood heavyweight Clark Gable, The Painted Desert finds Boyd and Gable at odds over the affections of a cowboy's beautiful daughter (Helen Twelvetrees).

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux tribe fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Sioux's patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks. Directed and co-written by Sidney Salkow; starring Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish. Also, look for legendary character actor Iron Eyes Cody as Crazy Horse.

programme.title: Fugitive of the Plains
programme.desc: In this continuation of the much loved Billy the Kid serials featuring dreamboat Buster Crabbe (perhaps best known for his numerous appearances as Flash Gordon in the 30s and 40s), Billy finds himself joining an outlaw band led by women in order to, once again, clear his name after being wrongly accused of a crime he did not commit. Helmed by famed B-movie director Sam Newfield, this film also features Al St. John, whose lovable Fuzzy character was as essential to the PRC's Billy the Kid series as Billy himself.

programme.title: Revenge of the Virgins (Edited Version)
programme.desc: The angry and topless female members of a Native American prepare for battle when white treasure hunters move in on their sacred ground. Peter Perry Jr. (The Secret Sex Lives of Romeo and Juliet) directed this early nudie-cutie from a script by legendary cult filmmaker Ed Wood (Plan Nine from Outer Space). Writing under the pen name Peter LaRoche, Wood churned out this screenplay just before he reinvented himself as the author of seedy adult novels.

programme.title: Stagecoach to Denver
programme.desc: Ride the outlaws' highway! Allan Rocky Lane stars as Red Ryder, shootin' and fightin' his way to justice in this old slugfest from Republic Pictures. This time he's a stagecoach driver battling a crooked land commissioner and his cohorts, including a sheriff on the take. Robert Blake costars as Little Beaver!

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In this episode, Pat and Stoney are sent to Oklahoma to investigate a hanging judge. Stoney's plan to go undercover backfires when he is framed for murder himself. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney are assigned to investigate reports of an impostor posing as a U.S. Secret Service agent operating in Washington territory. In the guise of a government law officer, the man is shutting down all rivals of a saloon keeper's operating a crooked gambling establishment. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan. Originally aired in 1952 on NBC.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In General Delivery, the G-men crack a government swindle. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In Gypsy Traders, a band of gypsies settles down in the Montana Territory to take advantage of the copper stakes they've made in the region. In the nearby town of Bender, a group of shady locals believe the settlers should be stripped of their rights and take the matter to court. When it looks like the judge is going to rule for the gypsies, the outlaws kidnap him and lock him in the local jail.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Quick Hide the Railroad
programme.desc: Kate uses her charms to keep Homer Bedloe from catching the train to Pixley. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Bedloe: Charles Lane. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The President Who Came to Dinner
programme.desc: President of the railroad comes to visit the Shady Rest hotel with the intention to terminate the Cannonball's service. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Is There a Doctor in the Roundhouse
programme.desc: Railroad CEO Norman Curtis breaks the Cannonball's throttle lever, threatening the success of the Shady Rest Hotel's annual jamboree. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Norman Curtis: Roy Roberts. Directed by David Alexander.Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Courtship of Floyd Smoot
programme.desc: Kate's intentions are mistaken when she tries to help Floyd Smoot regain his confidence after being slighted by the woman he loves, a bride he had ordered by mail! Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Floyd Smoot: Rafe Davis.Directed by Sherman Marks. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In Family Ties, Judge Bean comes to the aid of the Peralta family as unscrupulous real estate agents try to force them off their land. They've learned that a railroad will need the property and they intend to make an undeserved profit. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In this episode, crooks posing as newspapermen attempt to blackmail a local rancher in order to steal his land and property. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery. In this episode, Judge Bean discovers that a young vagabond he jailed for a minor offense may be involved in a major unsolved gold heist.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery. In this episode, a con involving the Haunted Hills draws Judge Roy's attention. Letty is among those who undergo hypnosis to recall long past events.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 Judge Declares a Holiday
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, the judge meets up with a con man who comes to towns, arranges horse races then skips town with the receipts and all the money that was bet. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, an outlaw gang plans to take over the town by getting Judge Bean to resign over false charges of misconduct. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In this epsiode, Storts and Hurley are holding hostage a doll that brings good luck to a Mexican village. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, a couple of con men attempt to snare Letty into their scheme and spirit her away to San Francisco. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: Northwest Trail
programme.desc: Mountie Matt OBrien assignment is simple: He is to escort the rather grouchy, and slightly annoying, Miss Katherine Owens to a remote outpost. Things complicate however when they arrive at the outpost and he stumbles upon an illegal mining operation. Stars include Bob Steele, Joan Woodbury, and Poodles Hanneford.

programme.title: Winds of the Wasteland
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this Republic Pictures western about the final days of the Pony Express. Former rider John Blair (Wayne) enters a coach race to win a $25,000 government mail contract, but there are dozens of obstacles in his path. The rest of the cast includes Lane Chandler and Phyllis Fraser, plus Lew Kelly (Lady of Burlesque) doing a great comic turn as Rocky OBrien, the eccentric, self-proclaimed mayor of a deserted mining town.

programme.title: Doomed Caravan
programme.desc: Hoppy is enlisted to help protect Jane Travers' next caravan against robbers who have been terrorizing travelers. He comes across a wily pair of thieves who hve their men disguised as soldiers to escort the caravan. Hoppy isn't fooled for a second and busts up their plan with help from the Bar 20 boys. Not to be outdone, the thieves then capture everyone but Hoppy and puts them before a firing squad. Not it's up to Hoppy to rescue his friends singlehandedly. The cast includes William Boyd as Hopalong Cassidy, with Russell Hayden and Andy Clyde as Luky Jenkins and California Jack. For those counting, this was the 32nd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. They would be edited for syndication on television, bringing Hoppy and his friends to a whole new generation of fans.

programme.title: Ghost Town Gold [The Three Mesquiteers]
programme.desc: CAVALIERS OF THE CACTUS COUNTRY--ALWAYS READY FOR A FIGHT OR A FROLICK! The second entry in what would grow into a wildly popular series of Western Three Mesquiteers B-Movies produced by Republic Pictures, Ghost Town Gold tracks the titular trio as they attempt to recover the gold stolen by a gang in its effort to ruin the bank/mayor who ordered them to leave town. Frequent John Wayne collaborator Joseph Kane adds his signature directorial panache to this rousing shoot-em-up, setting the tone for a film series that was so rampantly successful, it spawned 50 sequels and a host of imitators from rival studios.

programme.title: Courageous Avenger
programme.desc: Gold, gangs, and the heroic fight for life! Johnny Mack Brown (Billy the Kid, Coquette) stars in this western thriller about murders going on in a mining community. Its a story full of twists, where the greed for gold is only surpassed by the struggle for life!

programme.title: Outpost In Morocco
programme.desc: George Raft, Mary Windsor, and Akim Tamiroff star in this romantic drama from director Robert Florey (The Florentine Dagger, Daughter of Shanghai). Raft plays Capt. Gerard, a member of the Foreign Legion known for his romantic entanglements. He's assigned to escort an emir's daughter to her father's mountain citadel and learn about the emir's activities. Not surprisingly, Gerard finds trouble brewing! With footage shot in Morocco, this movie also features a beautiful musical score by twotime Oscar nominee Michel Michelet (Voice in the Wind).

programme.title: Between Men
programme.desc: When his young son is shot, John Wellington kills the culprit and flees. But his son Johnny recovers and is raised by Sir George. Some twenty years later Johnny sets out to find Sir George's missing granddaughter. He finds her and also finds Rand, but neither of the two men realize they are father and son.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Bulldog Courage
programme.desc: Tim McCoy, one of the unsung heroes of 1930s western pictures, stars in a dual role. First, hes Slim Braddock, a miner who turns to robbing stagecoaches after being swindled by a banker. When Slim is murdered, his son Tim, also played by McCoy, seeks vengeance. Directed by B-movie legend Sam Newfield for Excelsior Pictures, this film is a showcase for McCoy, who appeared in more than 90 movies and in 1960 earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho protect a man being chased by outlaws who believe he is responsible for a gold robbery. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho break a woman out of prison before she is hanged for murder.Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog.. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: A town blames the son-in-law of a the bank president for his murder. Cisco and Pancho work to uncover the truth before the townspeople hang the man. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. This episode aired in 1950. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: After arriving in the town of Sundance, Cisco witnesses the destruction of a newspaper office. Upon seeing this, Cisco contends with the man trying to take over the town. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. This episode aired in 1950. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detectives Matt and Frankie face off with a murdering desperado who has been terrorizing the northwest. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Also starring Steve Brodie, RIchard Avonde, Helen Wallace, Gene Roth, and Edward Clark. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954 .Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 Wild Bunch of Wyoming
programme.desc: Matt and Frankie meet the Wild Bunch and their jovial leader Butch Cassidy.Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Also starring Joe Sawyer, Slim Pickens, Lane Chandler, and Bob Carney. Directed by William Witney. Episode originally aired in 1954. Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Jim Davis stars as Matt Clark, a railroad detective who is investigating a railroad holdup. Starring Mary Castle. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954.Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Series won an Emmy in 1955. (This episode also features James Best (1926-2015), who would go on to appear on such shows as The Andy Griffith Show, Bonanza, and The Dukes of Hazzard.)

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Matt Clark discovers the hideout of the famous Doolin gang. Clark, along with Detective Frankie, work to infiltrate the hideout and bring the Doolin gang to justice.Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Directed by William Witney. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle, along with Leo Gordon, Joan Shawlee, Don Kennedy, Kenneth MacDoNald, Patrick Waltz, and Ken Chryson. First aired in 1954.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After shooting Luke Grayson in self-defense, Ben Cartwright must protect himself from Graysons son, Todd, who seeks to avenge his fathers death.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Cartwrights try to invalidate a Spanish land grant to stop the De La Cuesta family from taking part of the Ponderosa and all of the Carson Valley settlers' land.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 Blood on the Land
programme.desc: Adam Cartwright finds himself hostage to Jeb, a dangerous sheep herder who wants Ben to sign over a large plot of land.Starring Michael Landon as Little Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben helps three deserters, escaped from an Army stockade. Learning what they had to deal with, Ben promises to share the truth with his friend who is in charge of the fort.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: In Old Cheyenne
programme.desc: Roy Rogers plays a newspaper reporter sent to Cheyenne to investigate a reputed troublemaker. While on the scene, he discovers who the real bad guys are, and sets out to right some wrongs. Also starring Roy's usual sidekick George 'Gabby' Hayes, plus Joan Woodbury, and George Rosener. This Republic Pictures western was helmed by director Joseph Kane (The Undersea Kingdom, Dakota) and features two musical numbers: 'Bonita' and 'Linda Flor'.

programme.title: Kentucky Rifle
programme.desc: His Wits, Weapons and Women, Turned Defeat Into Victory! A man brings a wagonload of Kentucky rifles through Indian Territory. Unfortunately the Indians realize what he has and offer the travelers an ultimatum: the rifles or their lives! Starring Lance Fuller, Sterling Holloway, Henry Hull, Chill Wills, Cathy Downs, and Jeanne Cagney, plus one of the great B-Western heels, I. Stanford Jolley!

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: The Trail Beyond
programme.desc: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is in search of a missing miner and his daughter in this Lone Star Picture. Along the way, Drew rescues his pal Wabbi (Noah Beery Jr.) from card cheats who have framed him for murder. You'll find plenty of action and suspense in this vintage horse opera, originally distributed by the kings of the B western, Monogram Pictures!

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Billy the Kid, Pat Garrett, and Doc Holliday ride again in Howard Hughes' epic 1943 western, but the character you'll remember most is sultry country vixen Rio McDonald. Hughes' nationwide search for an actress to play Rio resulted in the film debut of Jane Russell, whose natural assets were allegedly helped by a special bra designed by Hughes. When The Outlaw finally received a nationwide release in 1946, its success vindicated Hughes and made Russell a star. As for Hughes' infamous bra, Russell said in her 1988 memoir, I never wore it, and he never knew.

programme.sub-title: Whats On Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.desc: There is a unique energy that takes over the Mediterranean as the summer heat begins to build. This week, we are bypassing the usual tourist routes to find the heartbeat of the region through its most spectacular festivals. Imagine the sun setting over a lake in Tuscany as the Puccini Festival opens its 72nd season with the powerful melodies of Turandot. From that timeless elegance, we head straight into the high energy of Malta, where the Isle of MTV and the 10th anniversary of the Glitch Festival are turning the islands into a global hub for electronic music. We also explore the stunning heights of the Spanish Pyrenees for the floating stage at Pirineos Sur and hit the iconic cliffs of Santorini for the urban vibes of the Supa Dupa Fly Festival. This is a journey through a region that knows exactly how to celebrate its past while dancing firmly into the future.

programme.title: BP Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal 2026
programme.desc: The BP Ultimate Rally-Raid joined the W2RC calendar in 2024. The competition on Portuguese and Spanish tracks is always unforgettable for both cars and motorcycles. The event, organized by the Automóvel Club de Portugal, counts as the second round of the calendar. The rally offers a 1,200-kilometer route with wide and varied tracks: from the vast sandy beaches of the Alentejo coast to the busy roads of the Ribatejo region, not forgetting the rocky tracks of the Extremadura province in Spain. Diversity is the key word for the five days of racing! The bivouac is set up in the heart of the town of Grândola, in the province of Setúbal, 100 kilometers south of Lisbon.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and over time water can destroy the few clues the killer may have left behind.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Photography has long been a fundamental tool in homicide investigations. A single image can hold enough information to identify a suspect.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: When an untraceable poison is used as a murder weapon, investigators rely on forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental, forensics can reveal the deception just below the surface.

programme.desc: The methods of a murder itself can leave a lasting impression on authorities, especially when the tools of a killer's trade leave a victim marked for death.

programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with intuition but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof to uncover staged accidents.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Beneath a layer of trust can lurk a deadly obsession. In these cases, authorities employ an arsenal of forensic techniques to uncover the truth.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The Christmas Show
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: My Sister, The Homewrecker

programme.title: My Master, The Magician

programme.title: I'll Never Forget What's Her Name
